business_description.value: Qovery provides a production-grade Kubernetes and infrastructure platform that helps engineering teams provision cloud infrastructure, deploy applications, manage environments, and handle day-2 operations in their own cloud accounts.

cloud_signals.value: Qovery provisions Kubernetes clusters in customers' own cloud accounts across AWS, GCP, Azure, Scaleway, and other providers.
Qovery provides application deployment, environments, rollbacks, CI/CD integration, and preview environments.
Qovery operates a control plane while customer workloads, data, and secrets remain in the customer's cloud or VPC; it also offers a self-hosted control plane.

sales_summary.text: Qovery sells a cloud infrastructure and application deployment platform for provisioning Kubernetes, deploying workloads, and managing production operations in customers' own cloud accounts.
